entries.note: The shipper has sent the package's data; it is the first row of current histories.
The package record was created; older tracker versions show it instead of the manifest row.

entries.wording: Package information has been provided but the item has not been received for delivery. For more information please check again later.
entries.note: Status summary shown above the history while TForce has the shipper's data but not the package.
First scan as the package enters TForce's network.
TForce has received the package at a facility.
The package was loaded for its next leg.
The package reached the facility that delivers it.
The delivery row; its time column holds the delivery time.
Companion row to the delivery that names where the package was left, such as the front door.
The driver could not reach the delivery point.
The package was expected but missing from the load.
A generic exception row; the reason, such as short cartons, is printed in its location column.
Delivery estimate shown at the top of the history, not an event.
